Subject: SCCs appendix redline, subprocessor matrix and export profile — next steps

Hi Emma / AlderBio team,

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our discussion I've attached a focused redline that isolates the SCCs appendix and a separate subprocessor matrix so legal can review those artifacts without wading through broader MSA edits. Key asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm whether AlderBio needs the standard EU Commission SCCs (2021) or the combined controller-to-processor variant? We flagged a couple of controller/processor role bullets in the appendix for clarity.
- Please review the subprocessor matrix (separate spreadsheet) — we've annotated the entries that trigger cross-border routing (lines where hosting region != eu-west-1).
- We propose a short Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) to cover the limited exports to APAC for logging/monitoring; draft attached as proposed_TIA_draft.pdf.

If legal can get me a prioritized list of any non-standard language you'd like preserved, we can scope the commercial/legal team to accept/reject redlines quickly.

Attachments: AlderBio_MSA_OrderForm_v3_SCCS_appendix_redline.docx (redline of SCCS appendix), AlderBio_subprocessor_matrix_v2.xlsx (annotated), proposed_TIA_draft.pdf

Next steps: If you can circle back by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-02) on the SCCs variant and whether the TIA is acceptable in principle, we will run the final MSA bundle to procurement and security for signoff.

Cheers,
Jordan
Sales Director, Enterprise GTM

- If AlderBio wants the TIA, we need to know whether they require supplemental audit logs (they sometimes ask for monthly attestation).
